facts.text: Serve dessert when Reed's flower shop closes for the night.
facts.why: No source describes the shop closing, and the evening scenes happen elsewhere. The film closes with Julia and Reed starting a relationship.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Reed and Julia start their relationship.

facts.text: Edgar and Estelle, still holding hands after fifty-odd Valentine's Days.
facts.why: Sources only say 'long marriage' with no number, and the couple are in trouble that day after Estelle confesses an affair before they reconcile and renew their vows.
facts.fix: Edgar and Estelle, back together after a rough Valentine's Day.

vibe.verdict: Pleasant but muddled: a coffee-shop board with a coffee slogan on a flower shop menu, and most of the film's stories left out.
missing: Julia dressing as a waitress to confront Harrison
Sean coming out on national television
Liz's phone job and Jason's reaction
Edison's flowers for his teacher and Rani

Replace 'Pistachio chocolate-dipped strawberries' note with Edison's flowers for Rani
Rename 'Kara's anti-Valentine's pink fizz' note with 'I Hate Valentine's Day party'
